- Can you confirm whether you want us to show generation throughput (latency p95) or focus on cost-optimization (batching + quantization)? We’ll tailor the agenda.

Proposed slots (all ET):
1) Tue 2027-05-04 10:00–10:30am
2) Wed 2027-05-05 10:30–11:00am

Pick the one that works and I’ll send a calendar invite. If neither fits, reply with two alternative windows and we’ll find a match.

Preflight: make sure the sandbox API key name is visible in your project settings (so Diego can confirm access). I’ve attached a short demo agenda and a sandbox troubleshooting note.

Calendly (if you prefer self-book): https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-eval
